systems.system: Starlink kits at rural health facilities
systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Child Care
systems.tiers: More than 400 health facilities with kits received and not activated for want of subscription payments, 300 more to be added (health minister, National Assembly, July 2026)

systems.system: Digital centres with Universal Service Fund subscriptions
systems.owner: Ministry of ICT; Universal Service Fund
systems.tiers: The fund pays subscription costs for digital centres and schools only, for one year (ICT minister, July 2026)

note: The unactivated kits are at the health ministry's facilities, not at local government offices; no local authority office is named.
